sources.title: Post-Market Surveillance & lifecycle
sources.why: MDR's core post-market regime: actively monitor real-world performance, run PMCF, and report serious incidents after CE marking.

sources.title: SaMD Class IIb (MDR)
sources.why: Sets the class-specific vigilance burden: regular PSUR updates and at least annual post-market surveillance assessments for higher-risk software.

sources.title: CRA — Cyber Resilience Act (products with digital elements)
sources.why: Mandates ongoing post-market vulnerability handling, coordinated disclosure, security updates, and ENISA/CSIRT incident reporting.
